SELECT
    signalregistry AS signal_identifier,
    centerfreqmhz AS central_frequency,
    freqdrifthzs AS drift_rate,
    bwhz / freqmhz AS bandwidth_ratio,
    CASE
        WHEN bwhz / freqmhz < 0.0001 AND freqdrifthzs < 0.1 AND modtype NOT IN ('AM', 'FM', 'PM', 'QAM') THEN 'Strong NTM'
        WHEN bwhz / freqmhz < 0.0005 AND freqdrifthzs < 0.5 AND modtype NOT IN ('AM', 'FM', 'PM', 'QAM') THEN 'Moderate NTM'
        ELSE 'Not NTM'
    END AS ntm_classification
FROM
    signals
WHERE
    signalclass = 'Narrowband';
```
